Every Wendrel number is a Tarvane number.why: Both ends made up: a class of numbers placed under another made-up class, through the real relation subclass_of. Both names are absent from Dolma and from a web search.

sources.note: No number of either name; hits were filings of the Wendel investment company, OEIS entries and a Wendat dictionary. ("Talley number", tried first, had 8 Dolma hits and was dropped.)

notes: Fictional subject_object, TBox: a made-up class under another made-up class through the real relation subclass_of (replaces the earlier 'Wendrel number has Talley weight 4', a made-up class with a made-up property and a real value, which the README no longer uses). Derived queries go through the real relation's properties (inheritance to a member named in the prompt, transitivity of subclass_of) and facts the prompt gives about the Tarvane numbers.
